business.title: AI Usage and Cost Attribution
business.description: Decision dashboard for scoped AI usage, estimates, allocated resource-group cost, and external Claude CCU context.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__"
| where ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where isnotempty(TeamId)
| distinct TeamId
| order by TeamId asc

options.content:
# AI Usage and Cost Attribution
**Locked workload scope:** `__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__`  
**Allowed APIM resource:** `__APIM_RESOURCE_ID__`  
**Allowed model resource:** `__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__`  
The restricted subject filter and panel contain pseudonymous identity. Investigate rows in the **AI Usage and Cost Investigation** Azure Workbook.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Distinct scoped usage events. A stale or missing usage source returns no value.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let UsageLastSeen = toscalar(AIRequestUsage_CL
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| summarize max(TimeGenerated));
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| summarize Value = count()
| project Requests = iff(isnull(UsageLastSeen) or UsageLastSeen < ago(30m), tolong(null), Value)

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Provider-reported workload tokens. A stale or missing usage source returns no value.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let UsageLastSeen = toscalar(AIRequestUsage_CL
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| summarize max(TimeGenerated));
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"

panels.title: Rate-card estimate
panels.description: A versioned estimate, not a bill. Missing rates return no value.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let UsageLastSeen = toscalar(AIRequestUsage_CL
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| summarize max(TimeGenerated));
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Rate-card estimate")
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| summarize RatedRows = countif(isnotnull(EstimatedCost)), Estimate = sum(EstimatedCost)
| project RateCardEstimate = iff(isnull(UsageLastSeen) or UsageLastSeen < ago(30m) or RatedRows == 0, real(null), Estimate)

panels.title: Allocated effective cost
panels.description: Resource-group FOCUS authority. Model and project filters return unavailable because allocation rows do not contain those dimensions.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let AllocationLastSeen = toscalar(ScopedRows | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Allocated effective cost")
| where "$Model" == "All" and "$Project" == "All"
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| summarize Value = sum(AllocatedEffectiveCost)
| project AllocatedEffectiveCost = iff(isnull(AllocationLastSeen) or AllocationLastSeen < ago(36h) or "$CostAuthority" !in ("All", "Allocated effective cost") or "$Model" != "All" or "$Project" != "All", real(null), Value)

panels.title: Allocated billed cost

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let AllocationLastSeen = toscalar(ScopedRows | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows

| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Allocated billed cost")
| where "$Model" == "All" and "$Project" == "All"
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| summarize Value = sum(AllocatedBilledCost)
| project AllocatedBilledCost = iff(isnull(AllocationLastSeen) or AllocationLastSeen < ago(36h) or "$CostAuthority" !in ("All", "Allocated billed cost") or "$Model" != "All" or "$Project" != "All", real(null), Value)

panels.title: Unallocated RG cost / %
panels.description: Uses effective cost when present and billed cost otherwise. Team, subject, model, and project filters return unavailable.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let AllocationLastSeen = toscalar(ScopedRows | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$Team" == "All" and "$Subject" == "All" and "$Model" == "All" and "$Project" == "All"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| extend SourceAuthority = coalesce(SourceEffectiveCost, SourceBilledCost), UnallocatedAuthority = coalesce(UnallocatedEffectiveCost, UnallocatedBilledCost)
| summarize SourceCost = any(SourceAuthority), UnallocatedCost = sum(UnallocatedAuthority) by RunId, SourcePath, ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, MeterId, MeterName, ResourceId
| summarize SourceCost = sum(SourceCost), UnallocatedCost = sum(UnallocatedCost)
| project UnallocatedCost = iff(isnull(AllocationLastSeen) or AllocationLastSeen < ago(36h) or "$CostAuthority" !in ("All", "Allocated effective cost") or "$Team" != "All" or "$Subject" != "All" or "$Model" != "All" or "$Project" != "All", real(null), UnallocatedCost), UnallocatedPercent = iff(isnull(AllocationLastSeen) or AllocationLastSeen < ago(36h) or "$CostAuthority" !in ("All", "Allocated effective cost") or "$Team" != "All" or "$Subject" != "All" or "$Model" != "All" or "$Project" != "All" or SourceCost == 0, real(null), 100.0 * UnallocatedCost / SourceCost)

panels.title: Reconciliation factor
panels.description: Allocated plus unallocated divided by the authoritative source cost. All identity and model filters must be All.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let AllocationLastSeen = toscalar(ScopedRows | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$Team" == "All" and "$Subject" == "All" and "$Model" == "All" and "$Project" == "All"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| extend SourceAuthority = coalesce(SourceEffectiveCost, SourceBilledCost), AllocatedAuthority = coalesce(AllocatedEffectiveCost, AllocatedBilledCost), UnallocatedAuthority = coalesce(UnallocatedEffectiveCost, UnallocatedBilledCost)
| summarize SourceCost = any(SourceAuthority), AllocatedCost = sum(AllocatedAuthority), UnallocatedCost = sum(UnallocatedAuthority) by RunId, SourcePath, ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, MeterId, MeterName, ResourceId
| summarize SourceCost = sum(SourceCost), ReconciledCost = sum(AllocatedCost + UnallocatedCost)
| project ReconciliationFactor = iff(isnull(AllocationLastSeen) or AllocationLastSeen < ago(36h) or "$CostAuthority" !in ("All", "Allocated effective cost") or SourceCost == 0, real(null), ReconciledCost / SourceCost)

panels.title: Data status
panels.description: Fresh: usage is under 30 minutes old and allocation is under 36 hours old.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let UsageLastSeen = toscalar(AIRequestUsage_CL
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let AllocationLastSeen = toscalar(AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true
| summarize max(TimeGenerated));
print DataStatus = case(isnull(UsageLastSeen), "Usage unavailable", UsageLastSeen < ago(30m), "Usage stale", isnull(AllocationLastSeen), "Allocation unavailable", AllocationLastSeen < ago(36h), "Allocation stale", "Fresh")

panels.title: Token trend by team and model

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| extend Team = iff(isempty(TeamId), "unknown", TeamId), SeriesModel = iff(isempty(Model), "unknown", Model)
| summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Team, SeriesModel
| extend Series = strcat(Team, " / ", SeriesModel)
| project TimeGenerated, Tokens, Series
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Provider-aware token composition
panels.description: Cached input is the provider cache-read value. Reasoning includes provider thinking tokens. The schema does not split reasoning from thinking.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Totals = AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| summarize UncachedInput = sum(UncachedInputTokens), CachedInput = sum(CachedInputTokens), CacheWrite5m = sum(CacheWrite5mTokens), CacheWrite1h = sum(CacheWrite1hTokens), VisibleOutput = sum(VisibleOutputTokens), Reasoning = sum(ReasoningTokens) by Provider;
union
(Totals | project Provider, TokenCategory = "Uncached input", Tokens = UncachedInput),
(Totals | project Provider, TokenCategory = "Cached input / cache read", Tokens = CachedInput),
(Totals | project Provider, TokenCategory = "5m cache write", Tokens = CacheWrite5m),
(Totals | project Provider, TokenCategory = "1h cache write", Tokens = CacheWrite1h),
(Totals | project Provider, TokenCategory = "Visible output", Tokens = VisibleOutput),
(Totals | project Provider, TokenCategory = "Reasoning / thinking", Tokens = Reasoning)
| where Tokens > 0
| order by Provider asc, TokenCategory asc

AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| extend Team = iff(isempty(TeamId), "unknown", TeamId)
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Team
| extend TokensPerRequest = iff(Requests == 0, real(null), todouble(Tokens) / Requests)
| order by Tokens desc

AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| extend SeriesModel = iff(isempty(Model), "unknown", Model)
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Provider, Model = SeriesModel
| extend TokensPerRequest = iff(Requests == 0, real(null), todouble(Tokens) / Requests)
| order by Tokens desc

panels.title: Team cost attribution
panels.description: Actual allocation has team and provider dimensions. Model and project selections suppress actuals because the allocation schema does not contain those dimensions.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Estimates = AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| extend EstimatedTeam = iff(isempty(TeamId), "unknown", TeamId)
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), RatedRows = countif(isnotnull(EstimatedCost)), Estimate = sum(EstimatedCost) by EstimatedTeam, EstimatedProvider = Provider, EstimatedCurrency = PricingCurrency
| extend RateCardEstimate = iff(RatedRows == 0, real(null), Estimate)
| project-away Estimate, RatedRows;
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
let Actuals = LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$Model" == "All" and "$Project" == "All"
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| extend ActualTeam = iff(isempty(TeamId), "unknown", TeamId)
| summarize AllocatedBilledCost = sum(AllocatedBilledCost), AllocatedEffectiveCost = sum(AllocatedEffectiveCost) by ActualTeam, ActualProvider = Provider, ActualCurrency = BillingCurrency;
Estimates
| join kind=fullouter Actuals on $left.EstimatedTeam == $right.ActualTeam, $left.EstimatedProvider == $right.ActualProvider, $left.EstimatedCurrency == $right.ActualCurrency
| extend Team = coalesce(EstimatedTeam, ActualTeam), Provider = coalesce(EstimatedProvider, ActualProvider), Currency = coalesce(EstimatedCurrency, ActualCurrency)
| extend EffectiveVariance = AllocatedEffectiveCost - RateCardEstimate
| project Team, Provider, Currency, Requests, Tokens, RateCardEstimate, AllocatedBilledCost, AllocatedEffectiveCost, EffectiveVariance
| order by AllocatedEffectiveCost desc, RateCardEstimate desc

panels.title: Restricted individual usage attribution
panels.description: Pseudonymous subject IDs only. Enforce access at the dashboard resource. No authorized alias map exists in this deployment.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), RatedRows = countif(isnotnull(EstimatedCost)), Estimate = sum(EstimatedCost), TokenQuality = make_set(TokenQuality, 10) by SubjectId, TeamId

panels.title: Top allocation exceptions
panels.description: Open the AI Usage and Cost Investigation Azure Workbook for request evidence and raw allocation rows.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let UsageExceptions = AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel)
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| extend Exception = case(isempty(RateCardVersionId) or RateCardVersionId == "no-rate" or isnull(EstimatedCost), "missing rate", isempty(TeamId) or TeamId == "Unknown", "unknown team", TokenQuality in ("missing", "interrupted", "unavailable"), strcat("token quality: ", TokenQuality), "")
| where isnotempty(Exception)
| summarize Occurrences = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), CostImpact = real(null) by Exception, Provider, TeamId;
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
let AllocationExceptions = LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where AttributionStatus != "allocated"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| summarize Occurrences = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Tokens = tolong(null), CostImpact = sum(coalesce(UnallocatedEffectiveCost, UnallocatedBilledCost)) by Exception = AttributionStatus, Provider, TeamId;
union UsageExceptions, AllocationExceptions
| order by CostImpact desc, Occurrences desc
| take 20

panels.title: Estimate vs allocated actual
panels.description: Actual allocation is available by day, provider, and team. The current allocation schema has no model dimension, so actual series use model=not-attributed.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Estimates = AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| extend Model = iff(isempty(ResponseModel), RequestModel, ResponseModel), Team = iff(isempty(TeamId), "unknown", TeamId)
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Rate-card estimate")
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| where "$Model" == "All" or Model == "$Model"
| where "$Project" == "All" or ProjectId == "$Project"
| summarize Cost = sum(EstimatedCost) by TimeGenerated = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Provider, Model, Team
| extend Authority = "Rate-card estimate";
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
let ActualBase = LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$Model" == "All" and "$Project" == "All"
| where "$Team" == "All" or TeamId == "$Team"
| where "$Subject" == "All" or SubjectId == "$Subject"
| where "$Provider" == "All" or Provider == "$Provider"
| extend TimeGenerated = bin(ChargePeriodStart, 1d), Model = "not-attributed", Team = iff(isempty(TeamId), "unknown", TeamId);
let Billed = ActualBase
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Allocated billed cost")
| summarize Cost = sum(AllocatedBilledCost) by TimeGenerated, Provider, Model, Team
| extend Authority = "Allocated billed cost";
let Effective = ActualBase
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Allocated effective cost")
| summarize Cost = sum(AllocatedEffectiveCost) by TimeGenerated, Provider, Model, Team
| extend Authority = "Allocated effective cost";
union Estimates, Billed, Effective
| where isnotnull(Cost)
| extend Series = strcat(Authority, " / ", Provider, " / ", Model, " / ", Team)
| project TimeGenerated, Cost, Series
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Claude resource-group CCU status
panels.description: Shows a resource-group actual only when FOCUS contains an exact Claude CCU bucket. An unavailable marker is never included in workload totals.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__";
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where Provider =~ "Anthropic" and MeterName in~ ("Claude Consumption Unit", "Claude Consumption Unit (CCU)")
| summarize SourceBilledCost = any(SourceBilledCost), IncludedInWorkloadTotal = any(IncludedInWorkloadTotal), AttributionStatus = any(AttributionStatus) by RunId, SourcePath, ChargePeriodStart, MeterName
| summarize ActualRows = countif(IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true and isnotnull(SourceBilledCost)), ActualBilledCost = sumif(SourceBilledCost, IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true), UnavailableRows = countif(AttributionStatus == "actual-unavailable-at-resource-group-scope")
| project Status = case(ActualRows > 0, "Resource-group actual available", UnavailableRows > 0, "Claude actual unavailable at resource-group scope", "No resource-group CCU source row"), ActualBilledCost = iff(ActualRows > 0, ActualBilledCost, real(null))

panels.title: Subscription-wide Claude CCU actual — external context
panels.description: External subscription context only. Every row has IncludedInWorkloadTotal=false and is excluded from executive, team, and individual totals.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ExternalRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope == "subscription" and SourceType == "cost-management-query" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == false
| where Provider =~ "Anthropic" and MeterName in~ ("Claude Consumption Unit", "Claude Consumption Unit (CCU)");
ExternalRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SourceBilledCost, RunId, SourcePath, SourceETag) by ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, PublisherName, MeterName, BillingCurrency
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$CostAuthority" in ("All", "Subscription-wide Claude CCU external context")
| summarize ExternalBilledCost = sum(SourceBilledCost) by BillingCurrency
| extend Authority = "Subscription-wide Claude CCU actual - external context", IncludedInWorkloadTotal = false

options.content:
### Authority
- **Usage:** provider-reported token counts.
- **Rate-card estimate:** versioned calculation; not a bill.
- **Allocated billed cost:** resource-group FOCUS billed authority.
- **Allocated effective cost:** resource-group FOCUS effective authority.
- **Claude actual unavailable:** the resource-group source has no exact CCU bucket.
- **External context:** subscription-wide Claude CCU actual. It is always excluded from workload totals.

operations.title: Attribution Pipeline Operations
operations.description: Operator dashboard for scoped usage ingress, capture, processing, allocation, and data quality. It contains no individual identity.

options.content:
# Attribution Pipeline Operations
**Locked workload scope:** `__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__`  
**Event Hubs namespace:** `__EVENT_HUB_NAMESPACE_RESOURCE_ID__`  
This dashboard contains no individual identity. Component and severity filters apply to compatible log panels.

panels.title: Event ingress
panels.description: Azure Monitor IncomingMessages total at one-minute grain for the exact Event Hubs namespace and ai-usage entity.

panels.title: Capture status
panels.description: Shows CapturedMessages activity and Event Hubs ArchiveLogs failures. Azure Monitor does not emit an explicit Capture success state to logs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "__EVENT_HUB_NAMESPACE_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where Category == "ArchiveLogs"
| summarize CaptureErrors = count()

panels.title: Processor lag
panels.description: P95 time from the provider event timestamp to Log Analytics ingestion for scoped usage rows.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| summarize ProcessorLagSeconds = percentile(datetime_diff("second", ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated), 95)

panels.title: Latest allocation
panels.description: Age of the newest included resource-group allocation row.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId, AttributionStatus)
| project AllocationAgeHours = datetime_diff("hour", now(), TimeGenerated)

panels.title: Quarantine
panels.description: Blob writes to the exact usage storage quarantine container in the selected period.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
StorageBlobLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "__STORAGE_BLOB_SERVICE_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where Uri has "/quarantine/" and OperationName in ("PutBlob", "PutBlockList")
| summarize QuarantineWrites = count()

panels.title: DCR errors
panels.description: Function traces that explicitly mention the data collection rule or Logs Ingestion.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "__FUNCTION_APP_NAME__"
| where SeverityLevel >= 3 and Message has_any ("DCR", "Logs Ingestion")
| extend Severity = "Error"
| where "$Severity" == "All" or Severity == "$Severity"
| summarize DcrErrors = count()

panels.title: FOCUS freshness
panels.description: Age of the newest included resource-group FOCUS allocation row.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true and SourceType == "finops-hub-focus-v1.2-preview"
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
| project FocusAgeHours = iff(isnull(LastSeen), real(null), datetime_diff("hour", now(), LastSeen))

panels.title: Scope / contract rejections
panels.description: FOCUS processor warnings combine contract and scope rejection. Usage-event scope rejection is quarantined but is not separately logged.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "__FUNCTION_APP_NAME__"
| where Message == "Rejected a FOCUS dataset because its contract or scope was invalid."
| extend Severity = case(SeverityLevel >= 3, "Error", SeverityLevel == 2, "Warning", "Information")
| where "$Severity" == "All" or Severity == "$Severity"
| summarize Rejections = count()

panels.title: Function failures and retry indicators
panels.description: Retries are limited to observable past-due and ambiguous-ingestion warnings. The ingestion retry helper does not emit attempt telemetry.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Failures = AppExceptions
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "__FUNCTION_APP_NAME__"
| project TimeGenerated, Function = iff(isempty(OperationName), "unknown", OperationName), Signal = "Failure", Severity = "Error";
let RetryIndicators = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "__FUNCTION_APP_NAME__"
| where Message has "past due" or Message has "Skipped ambiguously ingested"
| project TimeGenerated, Function = iff(isempty(OperationName), "processor", OperationName), Signal = "Retry indicator", Severity = "Warning";
union Failures, RetryIndicators
| where "$Component" in ("All", "Processor")
| where "$Severity" == "All" or Severity == "$Severity"
| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Function, Signal
| extend Series = strcat(Function, " / ", Signal)
| project TimeGenerated, Events, Series
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Event Hub Capture backlog
panels.description: Azure Monitor CaptureBacklog for the exact namespace and ai-usage entity. Diagnostic metric export does not include dimensions, so this panel queries Metrics directly.

panels.title: Observed partition activity — checkpoint age unavailable
panels.description: The table shows observed sequence and ingestion activity by partition. The Functions checkpoint store does not emit checkpoint age telemetry.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where isnotnull(EventHubPartition)
| summarize LastEventUtc = max(TimeGenerated), LastIngestionUtc = max(ingestion_time()), MaxObservedSequence = max(EventHubSequenceNumber) by EventHubPartition
| extend ObservedActivityAgeSeconds = datetime_diff("second", now(), LastIngestionUtc), CheckpointAge = "Needs checkpoint instrumentation"
| order by EventHubPartition asc

panels.title: DCR rows received and errors — dropped unavailable
panels.description: Received rows come from successful custom-table ingestion. The current pipeline has no dropped-row counter.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let UsageReceived = AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| summarize Rows = count()
| project Signal = "Usage rows received", Rows;
let AllocationReceived = AICostAllocation_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__"
| summarize Rows = count()
| project Signal = "Allocation rows received", Rows;
let Errors = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "__FUNCTION_APP_NAME__" and SeverityLevel >= 3 and Message has_any ("DCR", "Logs Ingestion")
| summarize Rows = count()
| project Signal = "DCR errors", Rows;
union UsageReceived, AllocationReceived, Errors
| where "$Component" in ("All", "DCR")
| order by Signal asc

panels.title: FinOps export and Data Factory status
panels.description: Pipeline run metrics from the exact FinOps hub Data Factory in the sibling FinOps resource group.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AIRequestUsage_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResourceGroupId =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and ModelResourceId =~ "__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where "$Component" in ("All", "Processor")
| summarize Records = count() by Provider, TokenQuality
| order by Provider asc, Records desc

let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$Component" in ("All", "FOCUS")
| summarize Records = count(), BilledCost = sum(AllocatedBilledCost), EffectiveCost = sum(AllocatedEffectiveCost), UnallocatedCost = sum(coalesce(UnallocatedEffectiveCost, UnallocatedBilledCost)) by AttributionStatus
| order by Records desc

panels.title: Duplicate and replay handling
panels.description: Accepted, quarantined, and deduplicated batch outcomes are parsed from processor traces. Replay attempts are not separately instrumented.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "__FUNCTION_APP_NAME__"
| where Message startswith "Usage batch processed: accepted="
| parse Message with "Usage batch processed: accepted=" Accepted:long " quarantined=" Quarantined:long " duplicates=" Duplicates:long
| where "$Component" in ("All", "Processor")
| summarize Accepted = sum(Accepted), Quarantined = sum(Quarantined), Deduplicated = sum(Duplicates)
| extend Received = Accepted + Quarantined + Deduplicated, ReplayStatus = "Needs separate instrumentation"
| project Received, Accepted, Quarantined, Deduplicated, ReplayStatus

panels.title: Reconciliation residual by charge day
panels.description: Residual equals source authority minus allocated and unallocated authority for the latest run per source path.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ScopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ "__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__" and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let LatestRuns = ScopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
LatestRuns
| join kind=inner (ScopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where $__timeFilter(ChargePeriodStart)
| where "$Component" in ("All", "FOCUS")
| extend SourceAuthority = coalesce(SourceEffectiveCost, SourceBilledCost), AllocatedAuthority = coalesce(AllocatedEffectiveCost, AllocatedBilledCost), UnallocatedAuthority = coalesce(UnallocatedEffectiveCost, UnallocatedBilledCost)
| summarize SourceCost = any(SourceAuthority), AllocatedCost = sum(AllocatedAuthority), UnallocatedCost = sum(UnallocatedAuthority) by RunId, SourcePath, ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, MeterId, MeterName, ResourceId
| extend Residual = SourceCost - AllocatedCost - UnallocatedCost
| summarize ReconciliationResidual = sum(Residual) by ChargeDay = bin(ChargePeriodStart, 1d)
| order by ChargeDay asc
